goal: Deliver finite persistent demo scenarios and the first versioned schedule JSON adapter, preserving existing business rules.
dispatch_precondition: D1 accepted, final clean commit verified, developer idle.
scope: Implement exactly accepted v1.1 checkpoints C3, PRD P3/P4/P5, AC-DM03 full deletion layer and DM05–09/12 engineering.

Finite start/step/status/resume/play commands use existing HTTP APIs with current per-actor sessions. Persist safe progress and original operation IDs; one runner per scope, bounded termination, crash reconciliation, conflict/401/403 pause. No token or pairing code persistence; resume cannot grant role or invent fresh intent.

Versioned full schedule JSON source register/plan/apply/status: strict size/schema/coverage/time validation, stable external key mapping, explicit reviewed draft replacement then separate publish, CAS and source revision/hash rules. Old omitted in-coverage courses become explicit cancelled; no silent removal or partial import.
Atomic draft/mapping/batch/cursor writes and immutable provenance copy on publish, manual-edit markers, safe public summary, retention retaining mappings/version floor/current provenance.

Document data dictionary/storage ownership and practical commands/examples. Test real HTTP/process restart, concurrency, unknown-write and retention failure; retain historical evidence and freeze old migrations. Scoped local commit authorized.
out_of_scope: No arbitrary live DB connectors, member sync, dual write-back, general ETL platform, or automatic scenario execution at startup.
No D3 native network toggle/preview/upload/deployment/real data; no skipping accepted domain constraints.
acceptance: Applicable DM03/05–09/12 scenarios have exact final-source engineering evidence, including boundary/malformed input, replay/CAS/rollback/restart/cleanup.
Dynamic observations/member/schedule state persists and never renews TTL or restores revoked roles through restart/resume.
Plan cannot alter public/draft state; apply atomic and permission checked; publish separate; stable IDs/provenance and current data preserved through cleanup.
evidence_required: RESULT, reports/cp5/demo-scenarios per-AC matrix/logs, data dictionary/API/commands/synthetic JSON, affected regression/static checks, final source manifest and scoped clean commit.
stop_conditions: Stop after D2 delivery and await acceptance; D3 not authorized by this task.
Escalate ambiguous product behavior; fix domain bypass, silent overwrite, partial commit or replay defects before delivery. Unknown real gym backend is not a blocker.
